text_block_list.text:
The days go by as we continue our
community service together.
Today, we
have a special task lined up...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome! I know you! You're really
good at running!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A

text_block_list.text: Ohh, you know me? Uhh... Thank you?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Wow, your hair is so soft! You're even
cuter than you look on TV!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B

text_block_list.text: Huh?! I-I'm cute?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Super cute! I looove you!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B

text_block_list.text:
Er, um... You really shouldn't use that word
so lightly... Hey,
Tannhauser! Help me—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Her tail is so fluffy and soft, right? And
just look at those cute little
ears!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
No, don't encourage them! Ugh, why
meee?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Nature! Sing something for us! We
wanna hear a cute song!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B

text_block_list.text: Sing?! Come on, cut me some slack!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone! Today, we're going to
teach you little ones a few
things about
how we big Umamusume run!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Okaaay!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children

text_block_list.text: Pant... Wheeze... Nope, I can't do it anymore... Their innocence really hits you in the heart in more ways than one...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
We're not even that much older, Nature.
You're so overdramatic.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Hi there. Why don't you come over
here and play with us?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
...I know you. At the race before, you
caught a cold and couldn't run!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C

text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
My mommy said you always finish in a
good position. But isn't a "good
position"
usually first place?
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C

text_block_list.text: Urgh! Augh... Oof... I tumble.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Yep, there's that pure, unfiltered
innocence for you. You're gonna
need a
picker-upper after that blow. I'll buy you a
soda on the way
back.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone—this way please! You're
getting a real training
session today!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Aye aye, boss!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children

text_block_list.text:
How'd she get them so organized?
Meanwhile in this corner...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking. If you just zoom to the
front near the end of the
race, you'll win
for sure!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C

text_block_list.text:
Mhm, I see. Yeah, that's an interesting
idea. Thanks for the advice.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Getting schooled by a little kid... You're
just gonna let that happen,
Tannhauser?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As long as everyone's having fun.
Hm? Tannhauser, those notes
in your
journal...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Also, don't you know you get jinxed if you
eat curry before a race?
You won't be able
to run your best.
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C

text_block_list.text: Jinxed?! Wait, you have to tell me more! How can I break the jinx?!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Wait, you too now?! Am I the only one
thinking straight today?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All right! Looks like all the kids have gone
home! Shall we pack up?
...Oh?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you... Hehe. If you keep hanging
on to me like that, I won't be
able to go
back to my school.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Try not to catch any more colds, okay? I'm
rooting for you! I wanna
see you win!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child C

text_block_list.text: Yup, got it. I'm going to win! It's a promise!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Mu-muuun! BRING IT OOOOON!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Uh... Why the sudden outburst?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my best! I have to look cool
for that kid!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
What's the big rush? I thought you did
pretty good in the welcome
race. Better
than me, at any rate...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: What? You two were in the race?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Of course we were!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер and Nature

text_block_list.text: Oh, Kita... You should know better...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I'm really, really sorry! I was just so focused
on Teio, I guess I didn't
see anyone else!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
...Sure, I mean... who can blame you? None
of us can compare to a
dazzling
protagonist like Teio...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She makes winning look easy, then goes
the extra mile on top of that.
Next to her,
we're just your one-off support characters
there to spice
up the action.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: That's not true...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm serious. Teio's the real deal. No
one racks up the wins like
her.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Even so, I want to aim for the top! I'll run
with all my might and get
stronger... and
become someone people can look up to!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
You said it, Kita. I'm going to get stronger
too—just like McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Oh, to be so young and full of aspirations.
Wonder if I was like that
when I first
enrolled...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
